newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Gist-Brocades reports net profit up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Gist-Brocades reports net profit up 10 pct.

text.p: Dutch biochemicals and food group Gist-Brocades NV said on Wednesday its net profit rose 10 percent in 1996 as its sales exceeded the two billion guilder ($1.1 billion) threshhold for the first time in its history.

Gist said net profit rose to 158.5 million guilders from 114.1 million in 1995 while sales rose to 2.02 billion guilders from 1.84 billion. The company said it would pay a 1996 dividend of 1.60 guilder per share, up from 1.50 guilders in 1995.
Gist-Brocades said turnover rose because of takeovers, cooperation pacts and organic growth. Sales rose strongest in Asia and Australia, it added.
The company said its businesses were showing steady growth, adding that this year should bring a further rise in earnings.
"Provided exchange rate fluctuations are not excessive, we expect the profit before extraordinary income and expense for 1997 to show a clear increase on 1996," it said.
Gist-Brocades NV said all three of its divisions -- industrial pharmaceutical products, yeast and bakery ingredients and food specialties -- contributed to turnover growth in 1996.

The yeast and bakery ingredients made acquisitions in Brazil and Peru last year while the food specialties division made five acquisitions in the area of dairy ingredients -- two in Italy and one each in Australia, France and the U.S.
Gist said bakery ingredients and food specialties would both post higher profits in 1997 while earnings from industrial pharmaceutical products would equal those of 1996.

Gist-Brocades chairman Herman Scheffer said his company was interested in a possible acquisition of Unilever PLC/NV's Dutch flavours and fragrances unit Quest -- one of the chemical businesses which Unilever plans to sell off.
Scheffer told a news conference that Quest had some interesting businesses and that Gist would be interested in bidding for the company when Unilever put it up for sale.
"Quest has a number of activities which are very interesting for Gist-Brocades," Scheffer said. ($ = 1.878 Dutch Guilders)
